title: CLAUDE.md
text: zucbor R package encodes decodes CBOR (RFC 8949) ordinary R vectors lists, using vendored copy TinyCBOR C library system library required. CBOR JSON’s binary counterpart — maps, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null — plus native byte strings, exact 64-bit integers, semantic tags (dates, bignums, UUIDs). Intended properties shape every design decision: Decoding accepts raw vectors, files connections; validates structure building R object; enforces configurable depth size limits, input expected untrusted (network, IoT devices). Encoding deterministic: identical R objects produce identical bytes. Target uses: COSE WebAuthn passkey data, CWT tokens, CoAP device telemetry, IETF protocols moved JSON CBOR. fourth self-describing format family zujson, zuyaml zuxml (sibling checkouts ../). design question answered , look packages settle inventing something new — ../zujson/CLAUDE.md ../zuxml/CLAUDE.md detailed.

what: zucbor: Deterministic and Secure CBOR Encoding and Decoding — zucbor-package
title: zucbor: Deterministic and Secure CBOR Encoding and Decoding — zucbor-package
text: Encodes R values Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR, RFC 8949) decodes CBOR ordinary R vectors lists. Decoding checks whole input configurable depth, size item limits R object built, untrusted input network peers devices drive large allocations. Encoding deterministic: identical R objects always produce identical bytes. Uses bundled copy 'TinyCBOR' library (https://github.com/intel/tinycbor), system library required.

title: zucbor 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. cbor_decode(), cbor_decode_seq(), cbor_read() cbor_read_seq() turn CBOR (RFC 8949) CBOR sequences (RFC 8742) ordinary R values. whole input checked first – well-formedness, UTF-8, tag content, duplicate map keys (value), depth, size item limits – length header can never make R allocate data input hold. Every fault classed condition inheriting zucbor_error. cbor_encode() cbor_encode_seq() write RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding: identical R objects give identical bytes every platform, decoding re-encoding deterministic input reproduces exactly. cbor_validate() runs check alone; cbor_diagnose() shows CBOR RFC 8949 diagnostic notation, RFC’s examples write . cbor_map(), cbor_tag(), cbor_simple() cbor_bigint() represent values R native type : maps non-text keys, tagged items, simple values integers beyond 2^53. Bundles parser validator TinyCBOR 7.0; system library needed.
